name: Colour Mod
description: Per-channel brightness, contrast and gamma, then chroma. Order: brightness adds to each channel of the picture in display brightness (gamma 2.2), contrast scales each channel around mid grey, gamma raises each channel to 1 / gamma, and chroma scales the colour away from the pixel's luminance.

params.label: Chroma
params.doc: Colour strength, from grey at 0 to the picture's own at 1.

params.label: Brightness
params.doc: Added to the red, green and blue channels.

params.label: Contrast
params.doc: Scales the red, green and blue channels around mid grey; 1 leaves them as they are.

params.label: Gamma
params.doc: Brightens the midtones of each channel above 1 and darkens them below 1.
